description: Change the nameservers of a domain at the registrar (domain owner only). mode managed = back to the ZapX nameservers; mode external = own nameservers (2-13 distinct hostnames that resolve). Switching to external nameservers means the DNS records at ZapX no longer answer for the domain. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

mode.description: managed = ZapX nameservers (DNS records editable here), external = own nameservers.

nameservers.description: External nameserver hostnames (mode external only, 2-13 distinct).

name: set_domain_nameservers
title: Set Domain Nameservers
